react_result.final_narrative_text: The 11 differentially abundant metabolites resolve to a coherent multi-pathway perturbation anchored in one-carbon metabolism and connected to glycerophospholipid biology. Four independent analytical paradigms converge on Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism (KEGG:hsa00260) as the primary cross-paradigm winner: RaMP ORA returns it at rank 1 with FDR = 3.1×10⁻¹⁶ and 7 hits (choline, O-phospho-L-serine, sarcosine, AMP, S-adenosyl-L-methionine, (R)-lipoic acid, L-cystathionine); mummichog returns the equivalent KEGG gly/ser/ala/thr module at rank 1 (p = 0.016) with 8 metabolites including choline, O-phospho-L-serine, sarcosine, and AMP. Cysteine and methionine metabolism (KEGG:hsa00270) independently achieves p = 0.0009 in MetaboAnalystR PSEA, sharing SAM and L-cystathionine as drivers and extending the sulfur-amino-acid story. Glycerophospholipid metabolism (KEGG:hsa00564) is rank 3 in MetaboAnalystR (p = 0.02) and rank 2 in mummichog (p = 0.040), anchored by phosphocholine and choline — connecting the choline pool across the one-carbon and membrane-lipid axes simultaneously. Biocytin appears in the mummichog biotin metabolism module (rank 5, p = 0.079), consistent with the one-carbon/folate cluster. Uridine 5'-monophosphate hits pyrimidine metabolism in mummichog (rank 10) and appears as a single-metabolite signal in MetaboAnalystR (p = 0.220). Cholesterol independently hits bile-acid biosynthesis (mummichog rank 3) and primary bile-acid secretion (MetaboAnalystR rank 8), reflecting the sterol-lipid arm of the response. The biological interpretation is a coordinated perturbation of one-carbon folate cycling (glycine/serine/threonine hub), trans-sulfuration (methionine → cysteine → cystathionine), methyl-group donation (SAM, choline), and membrane-phospholipid remodelling (phosphocholine cycle), with biotin cofactor and pyrimidine nucleotide arms as secondary components.

  "narrative_text": "The 11 differentially abundant metabolites resolve to a coherent multi-pathway perturbation anchored in one-carbon metabolism and connected to glycerophospholipid biology. Four independent analytical paradigms converge on Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism (KEGG:hsa00260) as the primary cross-paradigm winner: RaMP ORA returns it at rank 1 with FDR = 3.1×10⁻¹⁶ and 7 hits (choline, O-phospho-L-serine, sarcosine, AMP, S-adenosyl-L-methionine, (R)-lipoic acid, L-cystathionine); mummichog returns the equivalent KEGG gly/ser/ala/thr module at rank 1 (p = 0.016) with 8 metabolites including choline, O-phospho-L-serine, sarcosine, and AMP. Cysteine and methionine metabolism (KEGG:hsa00270) independently achieves p = 0.0009 in MetaboAnalystR PSEA, sharing SAM and L-cystathionine as drivers and extending the sulfur-amino-acid story. Glycerophospholipid metabolism (KEGG:hsa00564) is rank 3 in MetaboAnalystR (p = 0.02) and rank 2 in mummichog (p = 0.040), anchored by phosphocholine and choline — connecting the choline pool across the one-carbon and membrane-lipid axes simultaneously. Biocytin appears in the mummichog biotin metabolism module (rank 5, p = 0.079), consistent with the one-carbon/folate cluster. Uridine 5'-monophosphate hits pyrimidine metabolism in mummichog (rank 10) and appears as a single-metabolite signal in MetaboAnalystR (p = 0.220). Cholesterol independently hits bile-acid biosynthesis (mummichog rank 3) and primary bile-acid secretion (MetaboAnalystR rank 8), reflecting the sterol-lipid arm of the response. final_react_result.final_narrative_text: The 11 differentially abundant metabolites resolve to a coherent multi-pathway perturbation anchored in one-carbon metabolism and connected to glycerophospholipid biology. Four independent analytical paradigms converge on Glycine, serine and threonine metabolism (KEGG:hsa00260) as the primary cross-paradigm winner: RaMP ORA returns it at rank 1 with FDR = 3.1×10⁻¹⁶ and 7 hits (choline, O-phospho-L-serine, sarcosine, AMP, S-adenosyl-L-methionine, (R)-lipoic acid, L-cystathionine); mummichog returns the equivalent KEGG gly/ser/ala/thr module at rank 1 (p = 0.016) with 8 metabolites including choline, O-phospho-L-serine, sarcosine, and AMP. Cysteine and methionine metabolism (KEGG:hsa00270) independently achieves p = 0.0009 in MetaboAnalystR PSEA, sharing SAM and L-cystathionine as drivers and extending the sulfur-amino-acid story. Glycerophospholipid metabolism (KEGG:hsa00564) is rank 3 in MetaboAnalystR (p = 0.02) and rank 2 in mummichog (p = 0.040), anchored by phosphocholine and choline — connecting the choline pool across the one-carbon and membrane-lipid axes simultaneously. Biocytin appears in the mummichog biotin metabolism module (rank 5, p = 0.079), consistent with the one-carbon/folate cluster. Uridine 5'-monophosphate hits pyrimidine metabolism in mummichog (rank 10) and appears as a single-metabolite signal in MetaboAnalystR (p = 0.220). Cholesterol independently hits bile-acid biosynthesis (mummichog rank 3) and primary bile-acid secretion (MetaboAnalystR rank 8), reflecting the sterol-lipid arm of the response. The biological interpretation is a coordinated perturbation of one-carbon folate cycling (glycine/serine/threonine hub), trans-sulfuration (methionine → cysteine → cystathionine), methyl-group donation (SAM, choline), and membrane-phospholipid remodelling (phosphocholine cycle), with biotin cofactor and pyrimidine nucleotide arms as secondary components.
